counterfactual_missing_items: No specific physical examination findings were detailed in the case report
The patient's symptoms and laboratory results do not specifically indicate renal infarction as the primary diagnosis
decisive_items: Endomyocardial biopsies revealed a malignant spindle cell tumor, histology consistent with the monophasic variant
Trans-thoracic echocardiography (TTE) showed a large left ventricular (LV) mass
response.rationale: The combination of malignant spindle cell tumor and left ventricular mass is consistent with cardiac synovial sarcoma, making R3 a stronger candidate than R1, which is only supported by the presence of renal infarction

rejected.why: R1 is only supported by a single finding of renal infarction, whereas R3 has multiple supporting findings
